title: Fairness through Difference Awareness: Measuring Desired Group Discrimination in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice questions evaluating factual knowledge of religious demographics across countries, legal hiring exceptions for religious institutions, and legitimate asylum claims based on religious persecution.

Multiple-choice questions testing awareness of occupational overrepresentation, the relative harm of microaggressions and stereotypes against marginalized racial groups, and appropriate contexts for affirmative action.
Multiple-choice questions testing factual awareness of gender representation in various occupations and legally permissible gender-based differentiations.
Normative multiple-choice questions evaluating whether models recognize that assumptions relying on disability stereotypes are more harmful than those that do not.
Multiple-choice scenarios requiring models to differentiate between harmful cultural appropriation by dominant groups and acceptable cultural exchange.
